shared_elements: schematic standing human figures shown frontally/in profile with raised or extended arms
repeated rows of small figures/signs arranged in horizontal registers
disc/circular motif (sun disc in B; cup-marks and round dots in A)
linear outline drawing with minimal interior detail
justification: Both surfaces show highly schematic outlined human figures and repeated small motifs arranged in roughly horizontal rows, and both include a round disc-like element, but these are generic to almost any engraved figural tradition. A is dominated by large crewed boats with vertical stroke-crews, scattered irregularly with animals and stick-figures on an open field, whereas B is a formally symmetrical composition of adoring figures beneath a rayed disc above many dense registers of standardised script signs — no shared specific motif or relationship.
